business_summary: China Ever Grand Financial Leasing Group Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the production, trade, wholesale, and distribution of daily necessities, medical products, and health and hygiene products in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. The company operates through Distribution, Manufacturing, Investment, and Financial leasing. It is involved in research, development, manufacture, and sale of food products, new food ingredients, and nutritional enhancers, as well as instant food and beverage products. The company also invests in securities and properties; and provides money lending, treasury investment, and office management services; and finance lease consulting services and financing services. China Ever Grand Financial Leasing Group Co., Ltd. was formerly known as PME Group Limited and changed its name to China Ever Grand Financial Leasing Group Co., Ltd. in February 2016. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 China Ever Grand Financial Leasing Group Co., Ltd.는 중화인민공화국과 홍콩에서 생필품, 의료 제품, 보건 및 위생 제품의 생산, 무역, 도매, 유통에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 유통, 제조, 투자 및 금융리스를 통해 운영됩니다. 식품, 신식품원료, 영양강화제, 즉석식품 및 음료제품의 연구, 개발, 제조, 판매를 담당하고 있습니다. 회사는 또한 증권과 부동산에 투자합니다. 자금 대출, 국고 투자 및 사무실 관리 서비스를 제공합니다. 금융리스 컨설팅 서비스 및 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. China Ever Grand Financial Leasing Group Co., Ltd.는 이전에 PME Group Limited로 알려졌으며 2016년 2월에 China Ever Grand Financial Leasing Group Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 2002년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
